resources.string: This Apple ID is used by another account

This Google account is used by another account
Switching opens the apps made with that Google account. Apps you made anonymously won\'t carry over and will no longer be visible on this device.

Sign in with Google or Apple to keep your apps and data. If you stay anonymous and delete the app or change phones, you can\'t get back to your apps.
